requirements.Title: NGB Keyed Bottles with Increased Page Yield
requirements.Description: Develop new NGB keyed ink bottles supporting 6K Black and 6K CMY page yield, with CMY bottle size greater than 8K.
requirements.Rationale: To meet higher page yield requirements and remain competitive in the market.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires compatibility with Magi/Nessie ink and NOA-F system.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: New bottles are available, compatible with system, and deliver specified yields in testing.

requirements.Title: Spill-Free Reliability for Ink Bottles
requirements.Description: Ensure the new ink bottles and system provide spill-free reliability during all use cases.
requirements.Rationale: Improves user experience and reduces mess and maintenance issues.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires new bottle design and integration with NOA-F.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: No ink spills detected in user and lab testing across defined scenarios.

requirements.Title: NOA-F with Metal Foiled Labyrinth and Lid Label
requirements.Description: Integrate NOA-F (Next-Generation Output Assembly - Filter) with a metal foiled labyrinth and a labeled lid, maintaining current click on push-push and TDF mechanisms.
requirements.Rationale: Enhances reliability and traceability while maintaining proven usability features.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on NOA-F design and labeling process.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: NOA-F units pass reliability and usability tests and are correctly labeled.

requirements.Title: Reuse of SuperAmp Si PHA and Magi/Nessie Ink
requirements.Description: Reuse the existing SuperAmp Si PHA and Magi/Nessie pigment inks with no reformulation required.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces development cost and leverages proven components.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires compatibility verification with new bottle and system designs.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: No performance or compatibility issues observed in system integration tests.

requirements.Title: Reliability and Ink Stability Modeling
requirements.Description: Model and characterize reliability, Water Vapor Transmission Rate (WVTR), air gain, flow rate, and IDS, including startup and NOA-F End of Life. Model ink stability for both tank and its impact on Print Quality (PQ).
requirements.Rationale: Ensures the system meets durability and print quality targets over its lifecycle.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires data from new bottle/system configurations.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Models are completed and validated with test data; PQ remains within defined limits across lifecycle.

requirements.Title: Support for Services and Contractual Requirements
requirements.Description: Provide support for services/contractual obligations including NOA-F as service parts during warranty.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures warranty and serviceability commitments are met for customers.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires service part logistics and documentation.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Service parts available and process documented for warranty period.

requirements.Title: Acumen 6 on Lid
requirements.Description: Integrate Acumen 6 (presumably a security or tracking feature) onto the lid of the product.
requirements.Rationale: Improves security or traceability of consumables.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on lid design and Acumen 6 integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Acumen 6 is functional and verifiable on all production lids.

requirements.Title: Factory Line Modifications for NOA-F and Ink Cart
requirements.Description: Modify existing SA 14 production line for NOA-F, add Magi ink cartridge and labeling tool in Orcus 5, and prepare for assembly of PHA, Dry FI, USG, and push-push mechanisms in the printer factory.
requirements.Rationale: Enables efficient and scalable manufacturing for new components.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires Capex investment and process engineering.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Lines are modified, validated, and achieve defined production yields.

requirements.Title: Mold for 1 to 4 New Keyed Caps
requirements.Description: Develop molds for up to four new keyed caps to support the new bottle system.
requirements.Rationale: Supports differentiation and proper bottle-to-tank matching.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on finalized bottle/cap design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Molds are created, tested, and support production rates.

requirements.Title: Speed: 25/20 ppm (PDL: 25/19 ppm)
requirements.Description: Achieve print speeds of 25 pages per minute (ppm) for standard, and 25/19 ppm for PDL (Page Description Language) mode.
requirements.Rationale: Meets market expectations for productivity and competitiveness.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on platform and print engine.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printers achieve specified speeds in standard and PDL mode in benchmark tests.

requirements.Title: Customer Replaceable PHA and NOA-F
requirements.Description: Design PHA (Printhead Assembly) and NOA-F to be customer replaceable.
requirements.Rationale: Improves serviceability and reduces downtime/costs for end users.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires design for easy access and replacement.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Users can replace components without tools; validated in usability studies.

requirements.Title: Warranty Page Life Goal: 80k Pages
requirements.Description: Support a new warranty page life goal of 80,000 printed pages.
requirements.Rationale: Extends product value and aligns with service expectations.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires durability across all components.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printers reliably print 80,000 pages without major failure in accelerated life tests.

requirements.Title: SKU 2 (Hi + Hi PDL) PaaS Offering
requirements.Description: Provide a SKU 2 configuration with both Hi and Hi PDL features as a Platform as a Service (PaaS) offering.
requirements.Rationale: Addresses market segments needing flexible, scalable solutions.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on platform and software enablement.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: SKU 2 with PaaS is available and functional in target markets.

requirements.Title: Tank Size Increase and Input/Output Tray Alignment
requirements.Description: Increase tank size for higher yield and adjust input/output trays to align with tank protrusion and size optimization.
requirements.Rationale: Supports higher yield and maintains form factor usability.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on tank and tray design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Trays and tanks are compatible, and fit within defined size envelope; validated in physical mockups.

requirements.Title: 4.3” CGD Display
requirements.Description: Integrate a 4.3-inch CGD (Color Graphic Display) into the product.
requirements.Rationale: Enhances user interface and accessibility.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires display integration with system firmware.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Display is functional, clear, and passes user acceptance tests.

requirements.Title: Platform with 4 Tubes and New Routing
requirements.Description: Leverage Sayan Sibstar tubes, implement four-tube platform, and develop new tube routing and integration.
requirements.Rationale: Supports ink delivery efficiency and reliability.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on tube design and integration with tank/system.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Ink flows reliably in all conditions; no tube failures in stress tests.

requirements.Title: Service Station Aerosol Management
requirements.Description: Modify service station for improved aerosol management due to tank changes and spit platform modifications.
requirements.Rationale: Prevents contamination and maintains print quality.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on tank and service station design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Aerosol containment meets defined standards in lab tests.

requirements.Title: Carriage Dynamics and Force Modeling
requirements.Description: Model carriage dynamics and force with new tube routing and increased weights.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures reliable print operation and longevity with new hardware configuration.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on finalized hardware design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Carriage operates within force and speed tolerances in all test scenarios.

requirements.Title: Paper Path for Increased Page Life
requirements.Description: Redesign paper path to support increased page life (80k pages).
requirements.Rationale: Ensures reliable paper handling over extended printer lifespan.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on paper path and component durability.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Paper jams and misfeeds remain below threshold in extended life tests.

requirements.Title: Ink Maintenance Serviceable Part (Post-80k Life)
requirements.Description: Design ink maintenance as a serviceable part at service centers after 80k page life.
requirements.Rationale: Extends printer value and reduces total cost of ownership for customers.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires service part logistics and documentation.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Service part is available and process is documented for post-warranty support.

requirements.Title: 140ml K Bottles and New CMY Bottle Sizes
requirements.Description: Introduce new 140ml black (K) bottles and new capacity CMY bottles.
requirements.Rationale: Supports higher yield and market differentiation.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on supply chain and bottle design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: New bottles are available and compatible with system; validated in yield tests.

requirements.Title: New IDS Startup Algorithm and Air Management
requirements.Description: Develop new IDS (Ink Delivery System) startup algorithm and air management.
requirements.Rationale: Improves reliability of ink delivery and printer startup performance.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on IDS hardware and firmware.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Startup success rate > 99% in defined test scenarios.

requirements.Title: New Make-break and FI Connection
requirements.Description: Implement new make-break and FI (Fluidic Interface) connection in IDS.
requirements.Rationale: Improves serviceability and robustness of ink connections.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on IDS redesign.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Connections pass durability and leak tests per defined standards.

requirements.Title: Leverage LEBI Ink-tank with Increased Size, Keying and LOI One SHAID
requirements.Description: Use LEBI ink-tank with increased size, new keying, and LOI One SHAID for improved reliability and security.
requirements.Rationale: Supports new bottle system, prevents mis-insertion, and improves tracking.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on tank and SHAID design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Tanks are keyed correctly and SHAID is readable in all units.

requirements.Title: New Servicing and Startup Algorithm
requirements.Description: Develop new servicing and startup algorithms to support new hardware and IDS.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures optimal performance and reliability for new system.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on IDS and firmware.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Algorithms pass reliability and usability tests; no startup failures in defined scenarios.

requirements.Title: New Print Quality Goals and Depletion Definition
requirements.Description: Set new print quality (PQ) goals and depletion definitions to align with new page yield targets.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures consistent output and clear end-of-life criteria for consumables.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on new ink and system configurations.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PQ and depletion thresholds are met in validation testing.

requirements.Title: Reuse Marconi Tux dASIC, Hannibal aASIC, Raccoon PSU
requirements.Description: Leverage existing Marconi Tux dASIC, Hannibal aASIC, and Raccoon PSU in the new platform.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces development cost and leverages proven electronics.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires compatibility with new system design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: No compatibility or performance issues observed in integration tests.

requirements.Title: Stingray Wi-Fi Module Integration
requirements.Description: Integrate Stingray Wi-Fi module into the printer platform.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures wireless connectivity and modern user experience.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires firmware and hardware integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Wi-Fi module passes connectivity and performance tests.

requirements.Title: FW Dune Firmware Platform
requirements.Description: Utilize FW Dune as the firmware platform for the printer.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures consistent software stack and supportability.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on firmware integration with hardware.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Firmware is stable and passes all regression and feature tests.

requirements.Title: Gauss4.xx Security for HW & FW
requirements.Description: Implement Gauss4.xx security features for both hardware and firmware.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures data protection and compliance with security standards.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires hardware and firmware support.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Security features pass internal and external penetration tests.

requirements.Title: EPEAT3, LOT4, Blue Angel Compliance
requirements.Description: Ensure printer meets EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel environmental and performance requirements for PDL SKU.
requirements.Rationale: Supports sustainability and regulatory compliance.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on product design and certification process.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product is certified for EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel standards.

requirements.Title: EPS Foam Packaging
requirements.Description: Use EPS foam packaging for the printer.
requirements.Rationale: Protects product during shipping and meets packaging standards.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on packaging design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Packaging passes drop and vibration tests as per HP standards.

requirements.Title: Business Model: Consumer, SMB, Enterprise; Services: PaaS, WorkFromHome/Flexworker
requirements.Description: Support business models for Consumer, SMB, and Enterprise segments, including Platform as a Service (PaaS) and WorkFromHome/Flexworker services.
requirements.Rationale: Expands market reach and adapts to evolving customer needs.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on platform and service enablement.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Business models and services are available and functional in target markets.

requirements.Title: Solution Support: Scan, SMB Manageability, Enterprise Support (WJA, HPSM, JAM)
requirements.Description: Provide solution support for scan functionality, SMB manageability, and enterprise tools such as WJA, HPSM, and JAM.
requirements.Rationale: Addresses diverse customer solution needs and enterprise integration.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on software and platform integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Solutions are available, functional, and validated with key customers.

requirements.Title: Clients & Drivers: HPX, PSA, SUPD, UPD, EasyStart, USS, UFD
requirements.Description: Support a range of client and driver software including HPX, PSA, SUPD, UPD, EasyStart, USS, and UFD.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures broad compatibility and ease of installation for customers.
requirements.Stakeholders: End Users, IT Departments, Product Management
requirements.Dependencies: Requires software integration and validation.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All drivers are available and pass installation and functionality tests.

requirements.Title: Protect Micro/SMB Segments and HP's Profit Pool
requirements.Description: Design product features and strategies to protect Micro/SMB segments and prevent HP's traditional ink/laser profit pool from shifting to competitors.
requirements.Rationale: Maintains HP's market position and profitability.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on feature set and market response.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Market share and profit pool metrics remain stable or improve post-launch.

requirements.Title: Lead with LaserJet, Flank with PDL in Medium/Enterprise
requirements.Description: Position the product to lead with LaserJet and flank with PDL in medium and enterprise segments to win over Epson as CISS grows.
requirements.Rationale: Improves competitive positioning against key rivals.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on feature set and market strategy.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Market share in target segments increases post-launch.

requirements.Title: Grow CISS Profitable Share in New Segments
requirements.Description: Expand CISS (Continuous Ink Supply System) into new market segments for profitable growth.
requirements.Rationale: Drives revenue and market expansion.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on platform and go-to-market strategy.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: CISS share and profitability increase in new segments post-launch.

requirements.Title: Highly Leverage Watt-LE Mech Platform, Marconi-Hi Product, and Solutions
requirements.Description: Leverage existing Watt-LE mechanical platform, Marconi-Hi product (Reddington ID), and solution stack for new product.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces development time and cost by building on proven platforms.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires compatibility with new features and components.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Integration with legacy platforms is validated and meets performance targets.

requirements.Title: Integrate CISS IDS, NOA-F, and Ink Tanks
requirements.Description: Integrate CISS IDS, NOA-F, and new ink tanks into the platform.
requirements.Rationale: Supports expanded functionality and reliability for CISS.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on system integration and design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All components function as an integrated system in validation tests.

requirements.Title: New NGB Keyed Ink Bottles
requirements.Description: Develop and integrate new NGB keyed ink bottles for the system.
requirements.Rationale: Supports differentiation and prevents incorrect bottle insertion.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on bottle and tank design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Bottles are keyed and pass usability and reliability tests.

requirements.Title: Serviceability: Maintenance Box
requirements.Description: Ensure the printer includes a serviceable maintenance box for ink waste and other maintenance tasks.
requirements.Rationale: Improves serviceability and lowers total cost of ownership.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on hardware design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Maintenance box is easily accessible and replaceable by service or users.

requirements.Title: Warranty Life: 2 Years or 80k Pages
requirements.Description: Support a warranty life of 2 years or 80,000 pages, whichever comes first.
requirements.Rationale: Aligns with market and service expectations.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on durability and reliability of components.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Warranty coverage is clearly defined and supported in documentation.

requirements.Title: Throughput: 25/20 ppm (PDL)
requirements.Description: Achieve throughput of 25/20 pages per minute in PDL mode.
requirements.Rationale: Meets productivity requirements for target segments.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on print engine and software.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Throughput is validated in benchmark tests.

requirements.Title: SMB Solution Support
requirements.Description: Provide solution support specifically for SMB segments, including manageability and serviceability features.
requirements.Rationale: Addresses needs of small and medium business customers.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on feature set and solution integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: SMB features are available and validated with representative customers.

requirements.Title: PaaS Schedule Optimization
requirements.Description: Optimize Platform as a Service (PaaS) offering schedule for timely delivery.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures competitive go-to-market timing.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on platform readiness and market strategy.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PaaS offering is launched on or before scheduled date.
